resources.string: Send direct traffic through the bundled ByeDPI (local DPI circumvention, no server needed)
One per line. "example.com" matches the domain and its subdomains; V2Ray syntax like "full:", "regexp:", "geosite:" is also accepted.
Raw byedpi (ciadpi) command line options. --ip, --port and --protect-path are managed by Guise. Leave empty to restore the default: -d1 -r1+s
Creates a profile that sends all proxied traffic through ByeDPI, so Guise can run without a proxy server
ByeDPI profile added to the current group
Try ByeDPI strategies against a few sites and pick one that works on this network
Find ByeDPI arguments that get through on the current network

Starts a temporary ByeDPI for each strategy and makes HTTPS requests to the sites below directly from the phone\'s current network (Wi-Fi / mobile data). Testing through a proxy node is not supported, so results only describe the network you are on now. Tap a result to apply its arguments or copy them.
Sites: %1$s\nStrategies: %2$d · %3$d requests per site · timeout %4$ds · %5$d in parallel
One byedpi command line per line. Lines starting with # are ignored; {sni} is replaced with the fake SNI.
%1$s\n\nThis replaces the ByeDPI arguments in Settings and reloads the service if it is running.
ByeDPI is currently off: enable it in Settings or use the ByeDPI-only profile.
